ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: blocks Ready to Promote when there are commits newer than the last clean verification.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Verification_Gate), AND(copado__Promote_Change__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_Change__c))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Clean"), OR(ISBLANK(Verification_Date__c), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(copado__Latest_Commit_Date__c)), Verification_Date__c < copado__Latest_Commit_Date__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: There are new commits since the last verification. Run Verify again, then tick Ready to Promote again.
